label: Fnac Marketplace
terms_note: Fnac (and Darty) marketplace seller contract; API partner id / key requested from Fnac technical support (Marketplace.api@fnacdarty.com) — documentation access is granted, not public; preprod / test endpoints exist (Darty BOMP preprod, catalogue staging); rate limits not read.

discovery.auth: api_key (partner id + shop id + key exchanged for a token at vendeur.fnac.com/api.php auth)

auth: 1. Seller signs the Fnac marketplace contract and asks Marketplace.api@fnacdarty.com for API partner credentials + documentation.
2. Call `auth` with partner_id, shop_id and key → token used on every subsequent XML call.
3. Sandbox credentials are separate from production.

endpoints.purpose: create / update / delete offers (price, stock, state)
endpoints.notes: product reference (EAN), price, quantity, condition; async → batch id

endpoints.purpose: orders; accept / refuse, ship (tracking number + carrier)

reference.limits: Not read. - API credentials + documentation on request from Fnac technical support. - Marketplace seller contract (Fnac / Darty).

reason: Fnac Marketplace seller API (https://vendeur.fnac.com/api.php/<service>; the Offers/Orders reference is handed out by Fnac on request and catalog-mp.fnacdarty.com/docapi is login-gated): every request is validated against mp-dialog.xsd. Authentication is itself an XML POST (<auth xmlns="http://www.fnac.com/schemas/mp-dialog.xsd"><partner_id>…</partner_id><shop_id>…</shop_id><key>…</key></auth> → <auth_response><token>) and each later call carries the token as an attribute of the request root (<offers_update partner_id="…" shop_id="…" token="…">). Re-checked 2026-09-25 against the new runtime: the token can now be placed into the request body (auth.token_body_path "@token" on an XML body) and the XML login answer is parsed, but session logins still send only JSON or form bodies. Remaining gap: an XML (namespaced-root) session login body.
